Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	Residential Buildings
10,planning framework,regulatory compliance
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 includes specific controls and requirements that residential buildings must follow."<<"regulatory framework, building regulations<SEP>The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 outlines specific regulations that residential buildings must conform to, including height and space standards.

Community Contribution Schemes	Residential Buildings
7
Community contribution schemes are relevant to residential developments, allowing for flexibility in the maximum floor space ratio based on contributions."<<"planning incentives, residential development

Commercial Buildings	Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022
9,planning framework,regulatory compliance
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 establishes guidelines that commercial buildings must follow regarding height in mixed use zones.<SEP>The plan establishes regulations governing the height and other aspects of commercial buildings in conjunction with residential regulations."<<"building permissions, regulatory impact

Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	Mixed Use Zones
9,land use,zoning regulations
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 includes regulations for mixed use zones where both residential and commercial activities take place.<SEP>The local plan provides guidelines for development in mixed use zones, affecting both residential and commercial structures."<<"development guidelines, zoning regulations

Commercial Buildings	Mixed Use Zones
8
Commercial buildings are permitted within mixed use zones and are subject to the specific regulations of the Inner West Local Environmental Plan."<<"zoning, building allowances

Floor Space Ratio Controls	Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022
8
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 includes specific regulations for Floor Space Ratio Controls affecting densification in residential and mixed use zones."<<"density regulations, planning framework

Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	Setback Requirements
9,building placement,regulatory framework
Setback requirements are specified by the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 to regulate the positioning of buildings on lots.<SEP>The plan outlines the Setback Requirements for front, side, and rear boundaries, which must be adhered to in residential developments."<<"building regulations, compliance

Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	Parking Requirements
8,development planning,parking regulation
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 includes stipulations for the number of parking spaces required for residential developments.<SEP>The local plan establishes Parking Requirements to ensure adequate parking facilities in new residential developments."<<"development standards, parking regulations

Floor Space Ratio Controls	Mixed Use Zones
development density,zoning impact
Floor space ratio controls apply to mixed use zones, impacting the allowable construction scale in these areas.

Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	R1 Zone
planning framework,zoning regulations
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 specifies regulations that apply to the R1 Zone regarding building height and floor space ratio.

Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022	R2 Zone
planning framework,zoning regulations
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 includes provisions that govern the R2 Zone concerning building height and floor space ratio.

B4 Zone	Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022
mixed-use development,zoning regulations
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 sets rules for the B4 Zone that apply to both residential and commercial developments.
